preflight_before_training: Verify official source, license, archive integrity, and enough disk space before download.
Check official task-0 BDDL/instruction/HDF5 schema against the already validated 50-episode native task-0 dataset; do not silently substitute if it differs.
Select exactly 50 episodes for each of tasks 0-3 and compute frozen train/evaluation manifests with no overlap.
Convert to a new LeRobot dataset root; verify images, 15-D states, 7-D actions, task_index/task text, finiteness, and exact sample counts with the current training loader.
Run a no-gradient balanced-loader smoke test proving each batch has exactly two examples per task and total per-task draws match the plan.
Validate same evaluator and strict deterministic settings on all four native tasks; do not treat expert replay as policy success.
Check GPU idle, configuration uniqueness, adequate disk, and nonexistence of all new output paths immediately before launch.

safety.github_hf_payload_policy: publish code, README, lightweight JSON only; no checkpoint, raw HDF5, Parquet, videos, or logs
